killedBy: the persistence controls (issue #249) builds its URL through the canonical form the Configuration menu previews, when the press starts the load (issue #1015)
the persistence controls (issue #249) builds the same canonical URL when the pane loaded its modules before the press (issue #1015)
why: Issue #1015. Use Production Save hands over its URL without `canonicalDevSearch`, which since #1015 arrives with the Developer Tools pane's modules rather than from a static import. The URL then differs from the one the Configuration menu would preview for the same flags (here `?utm=x&aimRay=1&dev=1&prodSave=1` instead of the canonical `?dev=1&aimRay=1&prodSave=1&utm=x`). Measured before the change: written against the static call on `cbf8285d`, this mutation SURVIVED all 61 tests in `hud.diagnostics.test.ts`; the two canonical-URL cases, one pressed before the load and one after, are what kill it.
